sender_description: B2B marketplace connecting buyers with surplus brands
qualifier_context: Pollen Direct helps businesses buy branded inventory at discounted prices, reducing sourcing risk and streamlining the process. We connect qualified buyers with authentic products from verified brand sellers.
ideal_customer_profile: Small to mid-sized B2B companies buying in bulk, especially wholesalers, distributors, retailers, and resellers
what_we_offer: Access to high-quality branded inventory at deep discounts through a trusted and streamlined buying process
strong_signals: Bulk-buying intent with specific product categories (e.g. beauty, electronics)
Resale/distribution relevance with plans for wholesale or retail sales
Surplus inventory pressure due to overstock, packaging changes, or market exit
Commercial urgency from seasonality, expansion, promotional periods, or portfolio rationalization
weak_signals: Generic interest in products without bulk-buying intent
Vague corporate updates without sourcing problems or commercial urgency
